labelSource: ClassLabel feature names read from the parquet file's HuggingFace metadata
overlapWarning: The soybean model card states its own held-out photos came from its training datasets. This dataset is a separate small public set, but its provenance relative to LeafNet is not documented, so overlap cannot be excluded.

exclusions.note: Declared exclusions are evaluated and content-hashed like every other image, then omitted from the measured metrics only. They remain in the JSON report and manifest with their reason. No image is deleted, relabelled, or altered.

macroOverMeasuredClasses.note: Average over classes with labelled examples only. A measured class with an undefined precision/F1 (for example, every sample abstained) is excluded from the F1/precision averages; see perClass for details.

macroOverAllClasses.note: Average across every class the model can emit. A class with no labelled examples in this evaluation set is unmeasured and is scored as 0, so this figure is a floor, not a field estimate.
